@graph.name: Minimal OO-LD quantity crate (m1 duration)
@graph.description: Minimal RO-Crate 1.3 packaging of an OO-LD Time (QuantityValue) instance. The OO-LD schema is the second entry of the @context array (RO-Crate 1.3 allows extra terms; note this makes the OO-LD term definitions, e.g. value -> qudt:value, apply crate-wide). The mainEntity is the instance inline in the graph (storage mode A); its keys are OO-LD terms, and since the schema aliases type to @type, the entity is typed after expansion. data/m1-duration.data.json holds the same payload externalized (storage mode B): a generic reader sees a plain File, an OO-LD-aware loader dereferences and inlines it against the crate root (see https://github.com/OO-LD/oold-schema/issues/109).
